provenance.objective: semi-Markov conditional log-likelihood of the ground-truth path: NLL(w) = sum_u [ logZ_u(w) - w.F(y*_u) ] / tokens + lambda*||w - w_identity||^2. Convex (linear numerator, convex logZ, convex quadratic). The L2 anchor is the ratified generative baseline, so lambda -> infinity recovers the identity-weight ablation arm exactly.
provenance.firewall: this generator imports no grading module; the grading of the fitted weights is downstream in fit_run.py and feeds no value back
provenance.assembly: fitted as independent parallel processes, one per outer fold plus the all-326 model, then merged; each part carries its own provenance and its own convergence record
